title: The harbor's proven-space rule follows the ticket's kind at BUILDME
intention: At the BUILDME crossing the harbor's proven-space rule (clearance.clear rule 2) admits a proof that is not in proven-space by the ticket's kind: a code-seam's proof that exists and whose PROVES names the ticket (x), or a bug's proof that its fixes field lists and whose seal is really red (y). Every other crossing, PROVED above all, is unchanged.
why: Outline 19.14.8 (Akien 2026-10-31: 'for new/changed code tickets the rule is x, for fixit tickets the rule is y' ... 'yes, fold it in and build it'). Measured: rule 2 refuses every BUILDME onto an unsealed or red proof, so a red-first code-seam cannot name its own proof (the retreat-and-recross detour on 668c8d64b4e2 and e8b58520aeb9) and a fixit cannot name the red it fixes (1d23d635f7ca is held behind test_hollow.py, sealed red 2026-10-30). The sieves are the bottleneck.
traces_to: CairnComponentOutline.txt 19.14.8, 19.14.8.1, 19.14.8.2, 19.14.8.3; Law 8 (PROVED still demands sealed green and hollow-measured); Law 1 (the detour is re-derived per red-first ticket). RULE 1: the harbor reads proof_coverage (a tool) through its public declared(), and the tester's rung 4 is a separate ticket.
how: In cairn/devices/cairn/machines/harbor_master/clearance.py: boat_owner_of merges the ticket's .state.json into the dict it carries (D1); rule 2's loop admits a not-proven proof at BUILDME through a new _admitted_by_kind(ticket, boat_id, proof, read) (D2, D3). Proven by cairn/devices/cairn/machines/harbor_master/proofs/test_the_proven_space_rule_follows_the_ticket_kind.py (D4).
falsifier: Done when cairn/devices/cairn/machines/harbor_master/proofs/test_the_proven_space_rule_follows_the_ticket_kind.py, under PROVES for 56280fc01410 keys 1-6, runs green under bin/cairn test: (1) a code-seam clears BUILDME onto an unsealed or red proof whose PROVES names the boat; (2) a code-seam is refused (Unproven) at BUILDME onto a proof that names another ticket, declares nothing, or does not exist; (3) a bug clears BUILDME onto a proof its fixes lists whose seal verdict is red; (4) a bug is refused at BUILDME when its fixes proof was never sealed, is green gone stale, or the red proof is not in fixes; (5) PROVEME onto a not-proven proof is refused for both kinds; (6) boat_owner_of('56280fc01410').ticket carries the node_class ticket_file.read_ticket reads. Wrong intent if any crossing other than BUILDME clears onto a not-proven proof.

decisions.text: D1: THE OWNER READ CARRIES THE WHOLE TICKET. The file is cairn/devices/cairn/machines/harbor_master/clearance.py (present). In boat_owner_of, inside the try that parses the plan into ticket, read the state file beside it with only the files-only calls test_clearance.py's test_the_read_reaches_nothing_outward admits: _state = ticket_path[:-len('.json')] + '.state.json'; if ticket_path.endswith('.json') and os.path.isfile(_state): _standing = json.loads(open(_state, encoding='utf-8').read()); a non-dict raises OwnerUnresolvable naming the file; ticket = {**ticket, **_standing}. The state's key wins, as ticket_file.read_ticket does; an unreadable state file raises OwnerUnresolvable through the existing except.

D2: WHERE THE RULE SITS. The file is cairn/devices/cairn/machines/harbor_master/clearance.py (present). In clear() rule 2, compute at_buildme = fold(canon_target(parse_workflow(workflow_str), target)) == 'buildme' once before the loop. In the loop, when not _read['proven'] and at_buildme and _admitted_by_kind(owner.ticket, boat_id, _one, _read) is True, continue (skip the raise). Otherwise raise Unproven exactly as today. 'proven' (the first standing reading kept for the witness) is still set from the first named proof.

D3: THE PREDICATE. The file is cairn/devices/cairn/machines/harbor_master/clearance.py (present). Module-level def _admitted_by_kind(ticket, boat_id, proof, read) -> bool. Resolve proof to an absolute path under CAIRN_ROOT when relative. kind = fold(str((ticket or {}).get('node_class') or '')). kind == 'code-seam' (x): the file exists and boat_id in proof_coverage.declared(path). kind == 'bug' (y): ticket's fixes is a list, the proof's resolved path equals one entry's resolved path, read['seal'] is a dict and fold(str(read['seal'].get('verdict'))) == 'red'. Any other kind, or a non-dict ticket: False. Import declared from cairn.tools.proof_coverage.proof_coverage at the top beside coverage_lacks.

D4: THE PROOF is cairn/devices/cairn/machines/harbor_master/proofs/test_the_proven_space_rule_follows_the_ticket_kind.py, already written red-first (teeth 1, 3 and 6 red before the build). It substitutes clearance.boat_owner_of and clearance.standing at call time and crosses unticketed, so no entry gate runs; nothing else is edited.

D5: THE WITNESS. The file is cairn/devices/cairn/machines/harbor_master/clearance.py (present). A proof admitted at BUILDME by D3 may never have been sealed, so clear()'s emit call writes proven_seal_date=(proven['seal'] or {}).get('date'), None when unsealed, instead of indexing proven['seal']['date']. D4's proof crosses with no history_path, so the chokepoint journals nothing and runs no entry gate, and only the harbor's rules are measured.
decisions.step: unlisted: the witness date for an admitted proof

builder_notes: WHERE: cairn/devices/cairn/machines/harbor_master/clearance.py and the one new proof. RUN: bin/cairn test --exec 'python3 <proof>' twice. HOLLOW: bin/cairn test --hollow 56280fc01410 --proof <proof>. The other harbor_master proofs re-seal after the build (the fingerprint moves); test_clearance.py is long. ORDER: red-first route (cross BUILDME on test_clearance.py, commit the proof alone, build, seal, retreat to TICKETME naming the new proof, re-cross).
